title: Test a type and bind it in one condition

blocks.text: Pattern matching for `instanceof` lets an `if` test a type and bind a variable in one step, and the variable can be used in the rest of the condition:

items: the text in upper case, when `obj` is a `String` longer than 5 characters;
the text unchanged, when `obj` is a `String` of 5 characters or fewer;

blocks.text: Examples: `shout("welcome")` is `"WELCOME"`, `shout("hello")` is `"hello"`, `shout(42)` is `""`, and `shout(null)` is `""`.

cases.says: A long String is shouted and a short one kept.
"hello" has 5 characters and is kept as it is.
shout(null) is "": instanceof is false for null.
42 and a StringBuilder give "": only a String is shouted or kept.

concepts: An if condition can test a type with instanceof and bind a variable used in the rest of the condition.
